_note: GenerateVideo calls for the hermit: a turntable and idle on S W N E. No walk, no attack and no death. Paths are absolute under /workspace/lk-art-redo. save_as is the file the next pipeline step reads. The turntable reads video/views/k-<DIR>.png. A clip reads video/dirs/<DIR>.png, which `hero_sprites.py hermit dirs` writes after the turntable. view-E is the flip of view-W, so k-E and dirs/E.png come from that flip.

args.prompt: Game character turnaround reference. The hermit stands perfectly still in a neutral idle pose on an invisible turntable and rotates a full 360 degrees at a constant speed, turning to show his left side, then his back, then his right side, then front again. Locked-off camera, slightly elevated looking down, no camera movement, no zoom, no perspective change. Plain flat white background, even soft lighting. The design stays exactly identical: a hermit with a long grey beard, a deep green hooded cloak the colour of the night pines, a dark brown robe, worn boots, empty hands, no weapon. No flashing, glowing or pulsing light: every colour keeps exactly the same brightness in every frame. Crisp sharp detail in every frame, no motion blur, no ghosting, no walking, no text.

Nearly static game sprite idle loop. The hermit holds exactly the pose, angle and facing of the first frame (facing the camera) for the whole clip. Only a very small breathing motion: chest and shoulders rise and fall by a few pixels. Arms do not move, body does not turn, feet do not move, head does not turn. No flashing, glowing or pulsing light: every colour keeps exactly the same brightness in every frame. Locked camera, no zoom, plain flat white background, even lighting, crisp frames.
